title: NVIDIA DGX Spark Developer Kit Turns a Desk Into a Supercomputing Lab
summary: At SC26, an annual supercomputing conference taking place this week in Chicago, NVIDIA is introducing the DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit for researchers, academics and developers. The kit is a four-node cluster of NVIDIA DGX Spark systems, each connected directly to its two neighbors in a ring, with an NVIDIA HPC SDK installation playbook coming […]
